CORE MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #6
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: CORE MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 12
   C. 4
   D. 32

2. Solve for x: x + 8 = 17. (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 8
   C. 10
   D. 17

3. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 42
   B. 36
   C. 24
   D. 12

4. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 36
   C. 90
   D. 18

5. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 156
   B. 24
   C. 48
   D. 144

6. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 37
   C. 5
   D. 13

7. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 57
   B. 56
   C. 1
   D. 15

8. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 3
   B. 21
   C. 17
   D. 15

9. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 3
   C. 41
   D. 40

10. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 0
   B. 17
   C. 16
   D. 8

11. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 25
   C. 2
   D. 24

12. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 169
   C. 170
   D. 13

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
